description: Deterministic folded cortical ribbon with explicit MaSeg tissue labels; entirely synthetic.

supports.initial_membership: 255 within the binary brain mask; 0 outside
supports.tgdm_brain_bound: inside-negative/outside-positive unit-sign field derived from brain_mask for GenericTGDM bound semantics
supports.white_matter: 255 inside the analytic WM boundary; 0 elsewhere
supports.gray_matter: 255 in the analytic cortical ribbon; 0 elsewhere
supports.ace_gray_matter: same support and values as gray_matter
supports.ace_skeleton: zero everywhere to isolate nested-surface forces; MaACE is covered by separate source comparisons
supports.ground_truth_inner_levelset: radius minus analytic inner boundary; negative inside WM
supports.ground_truth_outer_levelset: radius minus analytic outer boundary; negative inside cortex

selected_maCRUISE_surface_evolution.provenance: TGDMBaselineParameters selected by run_ToadsCruise; WM iso is overridden to 0.6 in the base MaCRUISE core.

ribbon_quality_checks: inner, central, and outer meshes are finite, closed, manifold, one component, Euler characteristic 2, and RAS-mm
each adjacent pair is strictly nested with no zero/negative sampled ribbon thickness
WM label 44 is inside the inner surface, GM label 100 lies between inner and outer, and CSF label 5 lies outside the outer surface, with voxel-boundary tolerance stated in the report
Java/Python final inner/central/outer surfaces meet Dice >= 0.97, symmetric mean distance <= 0.01 mm, and Hausdorff <= 1 mm
positive finite thickness is produced wherever inner/outer surfaces have valid opposing closest points
